problem.outcome_html: The result: a smaller team, faster content production, consistent quality across every platform, and lower cost.

steps.h2: Get your content ready to publish in three steps

c1.feedTitle: Aerial display at the annual show
c1.p: Start with a file, a link, or an item you pick from the feed, then choose the language, sizes, and brand.

c2.p: Ekteb transcribes, translates, cuts, and applies your brand, then hands you a video you can edit or publish as is.

c3.p: Download the outputs, send them straight to your channels, or schedule the right post for each platform.

feed.h2: Discover what matters and turn it into publish-ready content in minutes.
feed.lead: Ekteb tracks more than 1,500 accounts and sources, so you can reach the latest content in one place and pick what matters to you. Then, with the help of AI, it transcribes, translates, and turns it into an on-brand video ready to publish across platforms.

features.h2_html:
A faster editor
for a smarter workflow
features.lead: Ekteb takes on the tedious, detailed work for you, so you produce more with consistent quality.

f1.p: Prepare your videos easily with tools to cut, trim, resize, zoom, blur, add subtitles, and edit audio. Use AI-powered editing suggestions, or manage every detail yourself in the browser-based editor.

f2.p: Turn your videos into text automatically, tell speakers apart, and translate your content into more than 30 languages. Compare the original text and translations on the timeline, and style your subtitles to match your brand's visual identity.
f2.demo2Tr: This is where it all begins

f3.p: Define your logo, colours, fonts, and templates once. Ekteb applies your brand identity to everything you prepare automatically, so you never have to rework it for each video.
f3.cap: Video statement from an official body

f4.p: Ekteb analyzes the most eye-catching frames in your video and suggests different cover images. Choose from the suggestions and prepare your covers in the right dimensions for the platform you're publishing to.

f5.p: Ekteb automatically detects the people in your video and follows the person you choose throughout the footage. It adjusts the framing around them, making it easy to turn multi-speaker videos like interviews and podcasts into vertical format.

f6.p: Choose which platforms to share your content on and set the publish date and time. Ekteb automatically publishes your videos to the social accounts you selected, at the time you set.

usecases.h2_html:
Ekteb is for everyone
who creates content
usecases.lead: From newsrooms to creators, and from social media teams to brands, Ekteb simplifies the whole journey from video production to publishing.

items.p: News agencies and TV channels producing video daily, at volume, across several languages.
YouTubers and influencers who want to scale their video output and reach a global audience without the overhead.
Companies running social accounts that need a steady stream of multilingual video every day.
For brands that want professional, localized video for global markets, fast.

enterprise.h2: A complete platform built for professional production

items.p: Your content is stored securely and is never used to train AI models without your permission.
Set your team members' access and permissions. Manage who can do what, by project and by content.
With open API support and integration options, easily bring Ekteb into your existing tools and publishing workflows.
Use Ekteb comfortably in your own language, with an RTL-ready interface and an Arabic-speaking support team.

items.q: What kind of content can I add to Ekteb?
items.a: You can upload a video directly to Ekteb, share a video link, add an article, or pick content from the visual feed. Ekteb creates a project for the content you chose, and you continue editing from there.

Ekteb supports transcription and translation in more than 30 languages. You can automatically turn the speech in your videos into text, translate it into other languages, and prepare multilingual subtitles.

The visual feed lets you discover the latest content Ekteb gathers from different sources, all in one place. Ekteb tracks more than 1,500 accounts and sources and analyzes around 20,000 videos every day. It filters out duplicate and low-quality content, then ranks about 200 standout items by importance and fit for publishing.

items.q: Can I edit videos before publishing them?
items.a: Of course. You can review the videos Ekteb prepares and make any changes you want before publishing, including the transcript, translation, title, description, video clips, cover image, and templates.

items.q: How does Ekteb protect my brand identity?
items.a: Just define your logo, brand colours, fonts, and templates in Ekteb once. These settings are applied automatically to your new content, so you keep the same visual language across the videos you publish on every platform.

items.q: Which platforms can I publish to with Ekteb?
items.a: With Ekteb you can publish content to your YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, X, and Telegram accounts. Share your videos instantly or schedule them for the date and time you want.

items.q: How does our team get started with Ekteb?
items.a: First, we assess your team's needs and current content production process together. Then we connect your accounts, prepare your templates, and train your team on how to use the platform.

meta.title: Privacy Policy | Ekteb
meta.description: How the Ekteb mobile app collects, uses and protects your data, and how to delete your account.

privacy.intro_html: This Privacy Policy explains how Ekteb (“Ekteb”, “we”, “us”) collects, uses and protects information when you use the Ekteb mobile app for iOS and Android (the “App”). By using the App you agree to the practices described here.

sections.body_html:
We collect only what the App needs to work:

  • Account information: your name, your email address and, where applicable, the organisation you belong to. Passwords are stored only in hashed form.
  • Content you provide: the projects, texts, subtitles, files and media you create, upload or save in the App.
  • Notification data: if you allow notifications, a push-notification token for your device and its platform (iOS or Android), so we can tell you when your content is ready. The token is removed when you sign out.

The App does not collect your precise location or your contacts, does not track you for advertising, and accesses files on your device only when you choose to upload them.

We use the information we collect to:

  • provide, operate and maintain the App and your account;
  • process the content you submit, for example to transcribe, translate, subtitle or summarise it;
  • send you notifications about your content, if you allow them;
  • keep the App and its users secure and prevent misuse;
  • answer your messages and requests.

We do not sell your data, use it for advertising, or build advertising profiles from it.

We do not sell, rent or share your personal data with third parties. To deliver notifications, the App uses Firebase Cloud Messaging (provided by Google) and Apple’s push notification service; they receive only your device’s notification token and the text of the notification, not your account information or your content.

We may also disclose information where the law requires it or a competent authority issues a valid order.

We keep account information and content for as long as your account is active. When you delete your account, we delete your personal data and content within 30 days, including from backups. Notification tokens are deleted when you sign out of the App.

Data is encrypted in transit using TLS, and access to it is limited to the staff who need it to run the service. No method of transmission or storage is completely secure, but we work to protect your information and to deal with any incident promptly.

Depending on where you live, you may have the right to access the personal data we hold about you, to correct it, to delete it, to receive a copy of it, and to object to or restrict its processing. To exercise any of these rights, write to privacy@ekteb.ai from the email address on your account. We reply within 30 days.

You can ask us to delete your account at any time by sending a deletion request to privacy@ekteb.ai from the email address on your account.

Deleting your account permanently removes your personal data and content as described under “Data retention”. It cannot be undone.

The App is a professional tool intended for users aged 18 and over. It is not directed at children, and we do not knowingly collect their data. If you believe a child has given us personal data, contact us and we will delete it.
We may update this policy from time to time. The “Last updated” date at the top of this page shows when it last changed, and we will tell you in the App before any material change takes effect.
For any question about this policy or your data, contact us at privacy@ekteb.ai.

funnel.title: Ekteb | From 20,000 items to one ready story
funnel.srDesc: Ekteb analyzes around twenty thousand items a day — video and written reports — drops duplicates and weak material, then ranks about two hundred items by priority and fit. One item becomes a project with transcript, translation, and brand applied, ready for review and then for publishing to YouTube, Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, X, and Telegram.
